ATL.name: Kingston Flemings
ATL.detail: Flemings (back) is out for Friday's game against the Hornets, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Jock Landale
ATL.detail: Landale (hip) won't play in Friday's game against the Hornets, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Asa Newell
ATL.detail: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: CJ McCollum
ATL.detail: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

ATL.name: Mouhamed Gueye
ATL.detail: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Henri Veesaar
ATL.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

BKN.name: Nolan Traore
BKN.detail: Traore (hamstring) won't return to Friday's game against Orlando, Meghan Triplett of YES Network reports. He finished with four points (2-6 FG, 0-2 3Pt) and two assists over 18 minutes.

BKN.name: Grant Nelson
BKN.detail: Nelson (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Orlando.

CHA.name: Grant Williams
CHA.detail: Williams (hamstring) is listed as out for Friday's game versus the Hawks.

CHA.name: Grayson Allen
CHA.detail: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Atlanta.

CHA.name: Kon Knueppel
CHA.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

CHA.name: Dennis Schroder
CHA.detail: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

CHI.name: Jalen Smith
CHI.detail: Smith (illness) is out for Friday's game against the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

CHI.name: Tobe Awaka
CHI.detail: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.

CHI.name: Caleb Wilson
CHI.detail: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

CLE.name: Jaylon Tyson
CLE.detail: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Indiana.

CLE.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
CLE.detail: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

CLE.name: Evan Mobley
CLE.detail: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

DEN.name: Julian Strawther
DEN.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

DET.name: Ronald Holland II
DET.detail: Holland (knee) is listed as out for Friday's game against Toronto.

DET.name: Taurean Prince
DET.detail: Prince (knee) underwent surgery to address lingering issues and has no timeline for a return, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

DET.name: Ebuka Okorie
DET.detail: Okorie (oblique) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Toronto.

DET.name: Ugonna Onyenso
DET.detail: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.

DET.name: Duncan Robinson
DET.detail: Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.

DET.name: Jalen Duren
DET.detail: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

GS.name: Draymond Green
GS.detail: Green (elbow) is out for Thursday's game against the Grizzlies.

GS.name: Brandon Williams
GS.detail: Williams (hamstring) has progressed to on-court activities and will be re-evaluated Saturday.

GS.name: Stephen Curry
GS.detail: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Kristaps Porzingis
GS.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

GS.name: Moses Moody
GS.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Jimmy Butler III
GS.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

HOU.name: Clint Capela
HOU.detail: Capela (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Denver.

IND.name: Tyrese Haliburton
IND.detail: Haliburton (hamstring) is expected to miss at least two more weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

IND.name: Johnny Furphy
IND.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

IND.name: Ben Sheppard
IND.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

LAL.name: Austin Reaves
LAL.detail: Head coach JJ Redick said he expects Reaves (heel) to return for Monday's matchup with Utah or Friday's game in San Antonio, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.

MIA.name: Myron Gardner
MIA.detail: Gardner (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

OKC.name: Alex Caruso
OKC.detail: Caruso (hip) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Pelicans.

OKC.name: Nikola Topic
OKC.detail: Topic (hip) is out for Friday's game against New Orleans.

OKC.name: Thomas Sorber
OKC.detail: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

OKC.name: Cason Wallace
OKC.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

OKC.name: Chet Holmgren
OKC.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

OKC.name: Jalen Williams
OKC.detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

ORL.name: Izaiyah Nelson
ORL.detail: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

ORL.name: Jonathan Isaac
ORL.detail: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

ORL.name: Noah Penda
ORL.detail: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

ORL.name: Paolo Banchero
ORL.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

PHX.name: Mark Williams
PHX.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

TOR.name: Kawhi Leonard
TOR.detail: Leonard (knee) could return in the next few weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

TOR.name: Collin Murray-Boyles
TOR.detail: Murray-Boyles (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pistons.

TOR.name: RJ Barrett
TOR.detail: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

TOR.name: Nate Bittle
TOR.detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.

UTAH.name: Jusuf Nurkic
UTAH.detail: Nurkic (foot) has been cleared for on-court work and will be re-evaluated in one week.

UTAH.name: Lauri Markkanen
UTAH.detail: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

UTAH.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
UTAH.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

WSH.name: Felix Okpara
WSH.detail: Okpara (illness) is available for Friday's game against Toronto.

WSH.name: Tristan Vukcevic
WSH.detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.

WSH.name: Reece Beekman
WSH.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

WSH.name: Justin Champagnie
WSH.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

WSH.name: Jamir Watkins
WSH.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
